name: Front split
instructions: Warm up well, then slide into a front split with the chosen leg in front. Log the side by the front leg.
Keep both knees straight, the front toes pointing up and both hips facing forward.
Support yourself with your hands or blocks, but do not let your hips rest on anything.
Hold your lowest controlled position for 3 seconds.
Have someone measure the vertical distance from the floor to the lowest point of your pelvis (the crotch). Flat on the floor is 0.
